title: Nvidia-Backed Pigment Nabs $250 Million to Challenge Microsoft
snippet: Pigment, a French AI company that competes with Microsoft’s Excel and PowerPoint, has raised $250 million in a funding round, bolstering a push by a prominent European startup to take on an American technology giant. The financing, set to be announced Tuesday, values the company at $2.3 billion.
